newsitem.title: JAPAN: OSE says has high hopes for stock options.
newsitem.headline: OSE says has high hopes for stock options.

text.p: The Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) said on Tuesday that it hopes trade in individual stock options on the OSE will be considered as important as such trade on overseas derivatives markets.
"We'll work so that we're viewed the same as Chicago and London when it comes to the derivatives market," OSE president Kyoji Kitamura told a news conference.
The OSE and the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) will list individual stock options on Friday.
